spans.s:
जठर जठर, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
जन्), hard, firm; old; bound, tied (?); yellowish (?);
(आस्), m. pl., N. of a people in the south-east of
Madhya-deśa; (अस्), m., N. of a mountain; (अस्,
अम्), m. n. the stomach, belly, abdomen, viscera,
bowels; the womb; a hole, cavity; the interior of
anything; the bosom; certain morbid affections of
the bowels; Ved. course (?); [cf. Goth. qvithrs,
Them. qvithra; Lat. venter ?].
—जठर-गद,
अस्, m. a morbid affection of the abdomen or bowels,
dropsy (?).
—जठर-ज्वाला, f. belly-ache, colic, en-
teritis.
—जठर-नुद्, त्, m. the plant Cathartocar-
pus Fistula; [cf. आरग्बध.]
—जठर-यन्त्रणा
or जठर-यातना, f. pain endured by the child in
the womb before birth.
—जठर-रोग, अस्, m. =
जठर-गद above.
—जठर-व्यथा, f. stomach-
ache, colic.
—जठर-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, or जठर-
स्थायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or जठर-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्,
being in the belly, being in the womb.
—जठराग्नि
(˚र-अग्˚), इस्, m. the digestive fire of the stomach, the
gastric juice [cf. अग्नि and जाठर]; a N. of Agastya
in a former birth; [cf. दह्राग्नि.]
—जठरामय
(˚र-आम्˚), अस्, m. dropsy, water in the abdomen.

जाठर जाठर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. जठर),
stomachic, abdominal, visceral, being in the stomach
or belly, relating to it, relating to the womb, e. g.
जाठरोऽग्निः, the fire in the stomach, the digestive
faculty, gastric juice, hunger; (अस्), m. ‘offspring of
the womb,’ a child; N. of an attendant of Skanda.

जठरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having a large belly; abdo-
minal, = उदरिन्, q. v.

जठरी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, contained in the belly;
concealed in the bosom.

जठल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), Ved. = जठर; (Sāy.)
the cavity or receptacle of waters, the ocean.
जाठर्य, अम्, n. morbid affection of the abdomen.
